none: PAS WILT-C989B2: Roman T shaped brooch
contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper alloy Roman Colchester derivative 'Dolphin' type brooch dating to the period c. AD 50 - 150. The pin is missing. The brooch measures 33.78mm in length, 28.39mm maximum width, 3.62mm wide at the base of the bow and weighs 7.31g. The head exhibits cylindrical wings.
